signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office
Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Take each product domain from a pile of opinions and requests to a clear vision, a prototype customers have reacted to, and a sequenced plan engineers can build against.
Coach the engineers who own those domains to run discovery and roadmapping themselves, so the whole team gets better at product instead of routing every decision through you.
Own the front door. Every feature request, from customers, sales or support, gets a clear decision and a reason, quickly.
Build a roadmap the company actually trusts: one where a Deployment Strategist or an AE can answer "when is this coming?" without pinging an engineer.
Get on the phone and on site with city and county staff. Ask the questions before showing the prototype, and come back knowing what they actually need.
